title: Users
description: Everyone who can open this home, and what each person is allowed to do.

form.createDescription: They sign in with this user name and password. Give them the password in person.
form.editDescription: Change how they appear and what they can do.
form.userNameHelp: Used to sign in. It can't be changed later.
form.disabledHelp: A disabled account can't sign in, and its open sessions end within a minute.
form.selfDisabledHelp: You can't deactivate your own account. Another administrator can.

reset.title: New password for {name}
reset.description: Set a new password and give it to them in person.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: Their account is removed and they can no longer sign in. This can't be undone.

selfDeactivate: You can't deactivate your own account.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.description: They can no longer sign in, and their open sessions end within a minute. You can reactivate the account later.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.description: They can sign in again with their current password.
